extension.summary: Stop Kodi, run amlogic-multistream, start Kodi again (player not included)
extension.description: RetroArch-style launcher for the amlogic-multistream player on CoreELEC. Launch stops Kodi, runs the player binary (default /storage/amlogic-multistream), and starts Kodi when the player exits. This add-on does not bundle or download the player AppImage/binary; install it at the Player binary path yourself. The GS-King X runs a 32-bit ARM CoreELEC Amlogic-ng userspace, so the x86_64 and aarch64 CI AppImages do not run there.
extension.disclaimer: Kodi is stopped while the player runs. Return to Kodi by stopping the player, for example: systemctl stop amlogic-multistream-launch
